name: The Watch (marked)
premise: Your believers are points of light and the dark presses in from every side.
loop: You hold a shadow-shield over one cluster at a time while the dark gnaws at every unshielded light. A text label marks who is safe and who is fading, and you drag coverage between clusters as the pressure shifts.
signals: A text label over each cluster reads SAFE or FADING so the player always knows the state.
outcome_win: Dawn arrives with the clusters you chose still burning.
outcome_fail: The lights you abandoned are grey by morning, standing exactly where you left them.
why_fun: Triage under guaranteed loss — the skill is deciding what to lose, and living with it.
gdd_quote: You shield what you can and you cannot shield everything
